title: Rethinking SAE Evaluation: An Atomic Interpretable Unit Framework Reveals Hidden Polysemanticity and Redundancy
abstract: arXiv:2610.30474v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) were originally motivated by discovering monosemantic features, a property that characterizes individual features but does not specify what the learned feature set should look like as a whole. As SAEs have increasingly been adopted for attribution, circuit discovery, and intervention, researchers have begun evaluating metrics that describe global properties of the feature set, such as sparsity, dead feature rates, reconstruction fidelity, and disentanglement, a diverse set that extends far beyond monosemanticity. However, this implicit shift beyond monosemanticity has not been formalized as a clear, well-defined objective that comes before these evaluation metrics. Without such an objective, existing metrics remain ad hoc, with their necessity unjustified. translated_title: 重新思考SAE评估：原子可解释单元框架揭示隐藏的多义性与冗余性
translated_abstract: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）最初是为发现单义特征而提出的，单义性是刻画单个特征的性质，但并未规定学习到的特征集合整体上应该是什么样子。随着SAE越来越多地被应用于归因分析、回路发现和干预，研究者们开始使用描述特征集合全局性质的评估指标，例如稀疏性、死特征比例、重建保真度和解耦性等，这一系列指标已远远超出单义性的范畴。然而，这种超越单义性的隐式转变尚未被形式化为一个清晰、明确定义的、先于这些评估指标存在的目标。缺少这样的目标，现有指标仍然是临时拼凑的，其必要性缺乏依据。在这项工作中，我们通过为SAE评估引入一种新范式来形式化这一最终目标：要求SAE特征，以及更广义的字典……（摘要不完整）
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于原子可解释单元的SAE评估新框架，将超越单义性的评估目标形式化，并借此揭示了现有SAE特征中隐藏的多义性与冗余性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a new atomic interpretable unit framework for SAE evaluation that formalizes objectives beyond monosemanticity, revealing hidden polysemanticity and redundancy in learned SAE features.
